app.name: Vib-Ribbon
app.short_description: The PAL PlayStation game, recompiled for the Wii
app.long_description:
Vib-Ribbon (Europe), statically recompiled to C and run on the PSXRecomp runtime.
Needs your own disc image and BIOS in sd:/apps/vibribbon/ (see the README).
Play with your own music: plug a USB CD/DVD drive into the Wii and put an audio CD in it when the game asks for one. Take it out to go back to the Vib-Ribbon disc.
HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel.
